name: First Shift
tip: Tap a stack to send its top container to the matching ship.

name: Make Room
tip: No yellow ship yet? Park the yellow box to get at what's underneath.

name: Chain Reaction
tip: Park all the yellows, then fill a ship. Watch what happens!

name: Plan Ahead
tip: Look at NEXT. Park the next ship's colour early!

name: Triple Threat
tip: Park yellow and green, then fill a ship. Three ships can sail at once!

name: Gold Rush
tip: Gold containers pay +10 coins when they reach a ship.

name: Two Roads
tip: Only 4 parking spots here. Think before you park!

name: Under Wraps
tip: Covered boxes show their colour when they reach the top.

name: Customs Hold
tip: A padlock opens after that many ships have sailed.

name: Graduation Day
tip: Covered boxes and a padlock together. Plan a chain and show what you've learned!
